messages:
henry_sales: Heads-up: Prospect AsterWell wants a POC with a guaranteed dedicated GPU pool for demo hours. Theyre proposing a 12mo commit (~$720k). Need pricing uplift and approval path.
maya_se: They asked for 24 v100-equivalent GPUs reserved 09:00-17:00 PST Mon-Fri. Outside those hours theyre ok with preemptible. Autoscale should be allowed within the reserved pool for burst to 32 if available.
leah_dealdesk: Key input needed: exact daily hour windows, region (us-west-2?), and whether they accept scheduled maintenance (we usually allow up to 4h/qtr). Also confirm if billing should be flat reserved or metered burst.
omar_finance: For a 12mo $720k commit adding a non-preemptible carveout for demo windows typically means a pricing uplift of 12-20% depending on pool size and region. If they allow metered billing for burst above 24 GPUs, we can keep uplift closer to 12%. Flat reserved burst to 32 GPUs pushes uplift toward 18-20%.
zach_ops: Ops: we can provision 24 guaranteed GPUs in us-west-2 but lead time ~8 business days. Autoscale to 32 within the dedicated pool is okay but we need to cap concurrent preemptible evictions. Also we require a maintenance window notice of at least 72h.
henry_sales: Customer insists no preemption during demo hours. They are OK with a maintenance window and want a price for both (A) reserved 24 flat, (B) reserved 24 with metered burst to 32.
legal_helper: Draft clause: "Provider will allocate a dedicated GPU pool during agreed demo windows. Provider may perform scheduled maintenance with 72 hours notice (max 4 hours per quarter). Providers failure to provide reserved capacity during demo windows will result in service credits as defined in the SOW amendment."
leah_dealdesk: Approval path: if uplift <=15% the deal desk can approve. 16-20% requires finance + CRO sign-off. >20% needs exec desk review. Action items: (1) @henry confirm region and exact window by EOD; (2) @maya submit infra ticket with manifest; (3) @omar produce uplift memo showing both pricing options; (4) @legal_helper prepare SOW amendment.
omar_finance: Ill run numbers and publish recommended uplift and monthly billing profile tomorrow AM.
henry_sales: Ok will confirm with the customer and update. Thanks all :thumbsup:
